stories.title: Reconcile every equity family and worker to accepted or planned scope
stories.scope: Audit the complete frozen command register including shared/mixed candidates; retain explicit in-scope, out-of-scope, accepted-reuse and unresolved dispositions. Reconcile all 78 equity family groups, original core definitions and cross-layer gaps. Every in-scope output/worker must have a primary numbered implementation or accepted-reuse story and release, not only an umbrella audit. Newly discovered gaps require explicit follow-up stories before this story can be accepted.
stories.validation: Independent inventory accounting, source-safe public manifest, no orphan/duplicate IDs, actual issue/milestone/Project/parent readback. Static reachability is not numerical completeness.

stories.title: Define and implement supplied session clock and trading-status semantics
stories.scope: Separate supplied trading/quoting/halt/resume/SSR events from inferred opening diagnostics. Specify session phase, early closes, elapsed/remaining session time, units, timezone/DST, unknown/stale state and ordered publisher/event transitions.
stories.validation: Independent calendar/event fixtures, boundary equality, missing/contradictory status and reset/replay cases; qualified supported input bindings.

stories.title: Implement calendar-period levels and extended-session aggregates
stories.scope: Specify prior/current week/month/YTD boundaries, target inclusion and calendar extrema separately from fixed-count windows. Specify premarket/extended-hours extrema, volume, changes and regular open under supplied calendars/eligible facts.
stories.validation: Independent holidays/week/month/year boundaries, early closes, DST, missing sessions, adjustments and phase eligibility; no fixed-day substitution.

stories.title: Implement explicit VWAP anchors and gap/opening-drive primitives
stories.scope: Specify caller-supplied causal anchor/reset identities and compatible VWAP reuse. Define scalar gap-fill/drive/crossing primitives separately from scanner/episode policies, with chronology, tie order and missing prior-reference behavior.
stories.validation: Independent tiny trade/bar paths, anchor/denominator/reset/correction fixtures; no future-derived anchor at origin time; compare direct and supplied-series paths.

stories.title: Qualify supplied classifications and reference/action gates
stories.scope: Complete required supplied sector/industry/universe/action/reference checks under known-at, effective interval, revision and declared coverage. Reuse accepted contracts and existing R6 provider stories; do not fetch providers or infer missing history.
stories.validation: Historical/current-only membership counterexamples, split/basis mismatches, missing/partial/observed-zero populations and cross-layer refusal parity.

stories.title: Qualify session and reference completion release
stories.scope: Audit exact selected R22 output/API/I-O/worker capability bindings, independent documentation and compatibility; preserve unresolved scope through new numbered stories rather than blanket completion.
stories.validation: Both-platform installed artifacts, independent math/time/status fixtures, bounded end-to-end baselines, applicable reviews/CI/publication/readback; all selected children accepted.

stories.title: Implement remaining price channels and squeeze primitives
stories.scope: Specify Keltner and Donchian channels, selected pivot levels, price-band width percentile and Bollinger/Keltner squeeze primitives. Distinguish primitive arithmetic from source-specific thresholds/policies and freeze exact input/seed/alignment dependencies.
stories.validation: Independent extrema/ATR/price-moment examples, zero ranges, short histories, target exclusion and separate readiness; no duplicate existing band/kernel implementation.

stories.title: Specify and implement admitted candle and structural-pattern evidence
stories.scope: Freeze a bounded explicit catalogue of candle/NR4/NR7 and selected geometric structures with original specifications, tolerances, deterministic ties, confirmation times and causal availability. No vague promise of all named chart patterns; omitted variants remain separately numbered.
stories.validation: Independent positive/negative/boundary fixtures including repaint/lookahead counterexamples and correction replay; scope decision before Ready.

stories.title: Complete remaining equity statistical projections
stories.scope: Resolve uncovered up-session fractions, core-benchmark agreement/dispersion, scalar SMA/relative momentum comparisons, dollar-volume/up-volume projections, drawdown/distance and trailing trade/notional rate projections. Reuse accepted primitives; freeze per-output units, population, zero/tie and window rules.
stories.validation: Literal small-array/tape expectations, missing anchors, nonmatching windows, observed zeros and target inclusion; explicit no-change reuse decisions and source-safe output manifest.

stories.title: Implement supplied point-in-time event and fundamental features
stories.scope: Define arithmetic over supplied earnings/analyst/insider/float/short-interest and scheduled corporate-event records, including counts and trading-session distance. Freeze required fields/units and coverage. Provider acquisition, text-model inference and rights remain separate existing/deferred scope.
stories.validation: Independent synthetic records, revisions/known-at, missing collections versus zero, dilution/units and event-calendar boundary cases; no provider operation required.

stories.title: Extend observed-path outcomes without signal leakage
stories.scope: Extend existing endpoint labels only where missing: sampled-path MFE/MAE, declared barriers, time-to-target and selected candidate/large-print outcome binding. Define maturity, observation resolution, origin identity, full path coverage and embargo; no tick-extreme or profitability inference.
stories.validation: Independent mature/immature paths and barriers, gaps, sampling/threshold ties, late corrections and unchanged origin signal bytes; labels never become current-feature prerequisites.

stories.title: Qualify remaining equity calculation release
stories.scope: Close selected new pure calculation/label scope with discoverable output manifest, correct source-independent packaging and qualified selected consumer bindings. Broader unselected patterns remain visible.
stories.validation: Independent numerical/temporal fixtures, clean both-platform artifacts, direct/worker parity where declared, measured resource-bounded workloads and actual acceptance/readback.

stories.title: Implement explicit equity scanner and watchlist catalogues
stories.scope: Inventory every selected equity scanner/watchlist identity; map to original public specifications and exact supplied feature/coverage dependencies. Reuse generic scan/rank APIs where valid; preserve matched/not-matched/unavailable and rule/version identity.
stories.validation: One source-safe catalogue ledger per selected identity with independent positive/negative/unavailable/tie cases; missing formula/rights stays blocked, not silently dropped.

stories.title: Implement selected strategy context, tape summaries and score profiles
stories.scope: Define original versioned component normalization, weights, tape summaries, profile joins and level selection with per-output readiness. Keep generic math separate from product/source policy and distinguish evidence from narrative.
stories.validation: Independent component/score examples, missing components, conflicting clocks/bases and unrelated-branch isolation; no future outcome input or performance claim from scores.

stories.title: Implement deterministic confirmation and candidate lifecycle
stories.scope: Freeze confirmation/persistence/reclaim/failure/episode transitions over supplied chronological evidence. Separate pure transition state from worker claims/retry/checkpoint persistence; specify identity, revision/reset, correction/replay and duplicate handling.
stories.validation: Independent transition tables and adversarial histories, replay/correction idempotence, no duplicate alerts, serialized identity chain with independent-identity parity.

stories.title: Implement same-identity score and membership history
stories.scope: Define score trends and membership tenure/persistence over causal same-formula/config/scope histories; do not substitute raw price history or revised future knowledge for historical score facts.
stories.validation: Independent prior-only trends/tenure examples, identity/config changes, missing sessions, late corrections and membership lifecycle boundaries.

stories.title: Qualify every admitted equity worker and I-O binding
stories.scope: For every equity and confirmed mixed/shared worker, link each output to accepted/new pure API, admitted source and sink, lifecycle/resource owner, installed worker route and exact dependencies. Reuse or consolidate commands without one-process-per-feature requirement. Audit acquisition, status, reference, history, publication, replay, maintenance and product-adapter roles. Out-of-scope options/product-only commands receive explicit exclusion or separate planning record. No private code/data migration without rights.
stories.validation: Complete worker/role/output traceability with no unplanned in-scope records; synthetic end-to-end full-result/status/quality/evidence and refusal parity, fault/recovery/readback, bounded CPU/RAM/I-O and direct/current alternatives. Provider/live/product operation gates remain separate.

stories.title: Accept complete planned equity family and worker coverage
stories.scope: Independently reconcile the full selected family/worker ledger to Done accepted scopes and separately tracked residuals. Every selected implementation, adapter, worker, policy, compatibility/documentation and release gate must be evidenced; no acceptance from syntax census alone.
stories.validation: Final no-orphan traceability; separate exact-head review/CI/both-platform installed artifacts and source/readback. Measure total time, throughput, memory and live latency only for declared supported workloads with result parity; retain all exclusions and failures.

scope: Future equity planning only; no runtime start or review authorization. Exact source-derived per-command/family rows remain local.
